answer.rationale: The mandate for 18% cost reduction combined with 14-day renewal deadline and 94% volume utilization creates high risk for both delay (defer_decision) and SLA failure (switch to low-cost vendor without safeguards). Memory_c2 warned against making the low-cost vendor sole source for critical lines. Memory_c4 shows successful margin recovery through renegotiation. Memory_c6 demonstrates that multi-year commitments unlock volume pricing. The optimal path is aggressive negotiation with the incumbent leveraging the benchmark data that worked in memory_c4, while securing the unit cost reduction needed for the 18% mandate. Verify memory_c2 to confirm the low-cost vendor's SLA risk profile and memory_c6 to quantify the volume pricing uplift from longer commitments. Negotiate_terms targets both cost reduction and relationship stability. This preserves optionality (can still add second source next cycle if negotiation fails) while addressing immediate deadline pressure without gambling on unproven vendor performance under volume stress at 94% line utilization.
